text:
You need someone who can develop marketing strategy for an entry-level project by translating customer insights into clear, cross-functional execution.  

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. In a marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit; 18% of ad budget was reallocated. In a parent survey analysis for Riverbend Education Fund, I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response survey and wrote the findings for the board; 3 findings were adopted in the next funding plan.  

I can help you turn customer data and team inputs into a practical strategy that supports execution across departments.
